summary: An environment conservation initiative was undertaken by the Interact Club to clean the beach after Ganesh Visarjan.
description:
An environment conservation initiative was undertaken by the Interact Club to clean the beach after Ganesh Visarjan. The drive focused on removing plastic waste and other litter left behind after the immersion, thereby promoting cleanliness, environmental responsibility and civic awareness among visitors.
please note : The project is Interact club- so 30 interactors involved.. Not Rotaractors as mentioned below.
